task: PM1_ALL publication to HF public dataset
root_cause: No pre-publication preflight: (a) no credential scan before public push, (b) no binary/LFS classification check, (c) no plan for per-hour commit rate limits.
what_went_wrong: Secret scan skipped -> live credentials reached a public repo (see separate high-severity record)
Binary files rejected: Hub requires LFS/Xet for binary blobs; small binaries (<10MB) were sent as plain git blobs
Repeated retry uploads exhausted the 128 commits/hour rate limit -> HTTP 429
First secret scan missed 06_Source_Repos/hf_space_deploy.git/config because it filtered by text-file extension only
remediation_applied: Full-tree secret scan incl. .git dirs and extensionless files; 36 files redacted (396 token replacements)
Installed hf_xet and upgraded huggingface_hub to 1.32.0
Switched to single create_commit for the final 516 files to avoid rate limit
lessons: Preflight checklist before any public publish: secret scan, binary inventory, rate-limit plan, history-clean guarantee
Secret scanners must not filter by extension; include dotfiles, .git internals, extensionless files
